w09q1.intro: Part 2 runs on questions. Units 11 and 12 build them: Does he? Does she? What does she do?

items.prompt: What ______ your brother do at the weekend?

items.teach: After does, the verb loses its s. Does he play, never does he plays.

items.prompt: ______ they going to the concert tonight?
items.teach: Tonight and going = present continuous, so it takes are, not do.

items.answer: What does your sister like eating
Where does he go on Saturdays

w09q2.intro: The real step up: five speakers, one list. Each speaker gets one thing from the list, and each answer is used only once. Listen right to the end of every clip.

items.say: I wanted to buy a football, but they had sold out, so I got a book about space instead.
items.prompt: What did the first speaker buy?
items.teach: “Instead” at the end changes the whole sentence. The football is the trap.

items.say: My mum gave me some money for my birthday and I'm saving it for a bike.
items.prompt: What does the second speaker want to buy?

items.say: I usually have a sandwich for lunch, but today the shop was closed so I had soup at home.
items.prompt: What did the third speaker have for lunch today?

items.say: We were going to go to the cinema, but my sister was ill, so we watched a film at her house.
items.prompt: Where did the fourth speaker watch the film?

items.say: It's my turn to walk the dog on Tuesdays, but this week my brother did it because I had a music lesson.
items.prompt: Who walked the dog this week?

w09q3.intro: Second set. The rule from Week 1 still stands: wait for the end.

items.say: I love painting, but at the moment I'm doing a lot of photography because I got a camera for my birthday.
items.prompt: What is this speaker doing a lot of at the moment?
items.teach: Painting is what she loves. Photography is what she is doing now.

items.say: The concert starts at seven, but we should leave at six because the traffic is bad on Fridays.
items.teach: Two times in one sentence. The question asks about leaving, not starting.

items.say: My favourite subject used to be maths, but this year I like science best.
items.prompt: What is her favourite subject this year?

items.say: Take your coat. It's sunny at the moment, but the forecast says rain this afternoon.
items.prompt: Why should he take a coat?

items.say: There were twelve of us at the party, but three people went home early, so only nine had the cake.
items.prompt: How many people had the cake?
items.teach: Three numbers, and the last one is the answer. Rushing this one loses it.
